orbittrieur.bouton.reglages.aide: Opens the panel: per-chest filters, radius, modes. (Shortcut: sneak + right-click the sorter)
orbittrieur.panel.actif.aide: Pauses or resumes sorting. While paused, items stay in the buffer.
orbittrieur.panel.regrouper.aide: An item with no rule goes to an inventory WITHOUT a filter that already holds it.
orbittrieur.panel.rayon.aide: How far inventories are searched (max %s). Shift = steps of 8, or scroll over the radius. Click Apply to search again.
orbittrieur.panel.surplus.aide: Overflow: this inventory gets everything the others refuse (only one).
orbittrieur.panel.remplir.aide: Fills the filter with the items already stored in this inventory.
orbittrieur.panel.appliquer.aide: Saves and searches inventories again without closing the panel.
